description: List leads the AI DM agent captured in the selected workspace, newest first, with their collected contact fields (email, phone, name, custom fields), qualification stage and conversation status. Filter by stage or by since (captured at or after); follow next_cursor for more pages. Returns personal data of the people who messaged, without the conversation transcript. Read-only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_inbox_leads
title: List Inbox Leads
